content: आवरण {%a.%} Covering, hiding, obscuring, obstructing; नेत्रावरणमश्रु <ls>R. 14. 71</ls>. .{@-णम्@} .²1 Covering, concealing, hiding, obscuring; सूर्ये तपत्यावरणाय दृष्टेः कल्पेत लोकस्य कथं तमिस्रा <ls>R. 5. 13</ls>, <ls n="R.">19. 46</ls>, <ls n="R.">19. 16</ls>. .²2 Shutting, enclosing, fencing. .²3 A covering, anything that covers or protects <ab>&c.</ab>; हस्तौ स्वौ नयति स्तनावरणताम् <ls>M. 4. 14</ls>; <ls>Ś. 3. 21</ls>; (<ab>fig.</ab>) protection, defence; शीलमावरणं स्त्रियाः <ls>Rām.</ls>; चरित्रावरणाः स्त्रियः <ls>Chāṇ. 76</ls>. .²4 Obstruction, interruption, restraint (of bashfulness <ab>&c.</ab>); कालेनावरणात्ययात् <ls>U. 1. 39</ls>. .²5 An enclosure, fence, surrounding wall; लब्धान्तरा सावरणेऽपि गेहे <ls>R. 16. 7</ls>; <ls>Ki. 5. 25</ls>. .²6 A bolt, latch. .²7 A shield. .²8 An armour; आक्षिप्तचापावरणेषु जालानि <ls>Ki. 17. 59</ls>. .²9 (in <ab>phil.</ab>) mental blindness (<ab>Jaina</ab>).
